description: Label-defining feature registry (§6 R1): which feature values an LF or operator may look at to assign a label. The masked training variant NaNs exactly these inputs on weak rows at train time (§11.5). Group entries cover many classes; entries never list the row's own label as an input (labels are never features).

synthetic_ops.note: Label comes from mutation_op + execution proof, not from feature values. Decoy operators (E1d) label CPP_OTHER_ERROR the same way.

lf_weak.note: Umaima's CodeStream weak LFs (U2), not yet built. Per-LF lf_inputs are appended when each LF ships its fixtures; source cap CodeStream = 0.85 (§3.5).

human.note: Human-confirmed rows (H2 audits, discovery confirmations, gold promotion). Input is the raw evidence packet, not a feature vector.

pg-1.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
pg-1.conjunction: verdict != ACCEPTED AND -Wparentheses AND AST assignment-in-condition whose assigned variable feeds an output computation (two distinct signals, §3.4)

pg-2.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
pg-2.conjunction: verdict = RUNTIME_ERROR AND recursion without guard (AST)

pg-3.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
pg-3.conjunction: verdict = RUNTIME_ERROR AND array write beyond fixed declared size (AST)

pg-4.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
pg-4.conjunction: verdict != ACCEPTED AND -Wmaybe-uninitialized AND use-before-init AST path

det-4.label: CPP_UNINITIALIZED_VAR
det-4.note: §13.5 candidate detector: -Wmaybe-uninitialized AND Valgrind uninit report. Excluded from any OTHER pool; routes to human review.

det-8.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
det-8.note: §13.5 candidate detector: AST comparison vs reference solution + order-reversed outputs. Never labels without human confirmation.

det-9.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
det-9.note: §13.5 candidate detector: failing boundary-pattern tests. Never labels without human confirmation.

det-10.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
det-10.note: §13.5 candidate detector: while-condition variables never assigned in the body (dataflow). Never labels without human confirmation.
